name: Trip to Tombstone
source:
Join Lilah, Valentina, and Trenton as they film their most ambitious video yet! A road trip across the Arizona desert as they search for many of the cryptids, creatures, and ghouls attached to it. Their main destination? The town of Tombstone, a near perfect time capsule of the old west! Surely there's a ghost or two roaming around.

[From [url=https://scrappydoodles.itch.io/trip-to-tombstone]Itch.io[/url]]
